name: Mobile Use (MadeAgents)
description: Android GUI agent that operates a phone over ADB from natural language, with a web interface and reflective multi-agent control.
whatItDoes: Executes everyday phone tasks across apps for a user who types the instruction. It is published by a research group and is also used for benchmark evaluation of mobile agents.
howItWorks: The agent captures screenshots through ADB and sends them to a multimodal model that selects an action, which is then applied to the device. Reflection at several levels checks progress and recovers from mistakes. It can be used as a Python package or through a browser-based control page.

requirements.name: ADB and an Android device
requirements.description: Phone or emulator with debugging enabled

requirements.name: Multimodal model endpoint
requirements.description: Key and URL for the vision-language model

models: Multimodal models such as Qwen VL via OpenAI-compatible APIs
